subject: Quick hosted API walkthrough — need to shift timing
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@retailrise.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API quick walk — availability

Hi Karthik,

I signed up through the self-serve flow this morning and poked around the sandbox — exciting stuff. I work on ML infra at RetailRise and would love a 30‑minute hosted API walkthrough focused on latency/cost controls and batching. Prefer weekdays after 11am ET.

Attached: retailrise-inbound-info.csv (brief note on our expected throughput and current infra).

Can you or someone on your team propose a few slots? We’re on EST (NYC). Also curious what pre-demo info you need so we don’t waste time.

Thanks —
Alex Turner
Sr. ML Engineer, RetailRise
alex.turner@retailrise.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@retailrise.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 10:03:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick walk — availability

Alex — thanks for signing up and for the details. Looping in Dylan from SDR/ops to coordinate a time and provision sandbox access.

Dylan: RetailRise (Alex) prefers post‑11am ET windows. They included a small throughput csv — looks like bursty traffic with many short sequences. Primary asks are batching, KV cache, and cost/latency levers.

Alex, for prep it helps to know:
- expected concurrent requests/sec (rough ballpark)
- token length distribution (avg prompt + response)
- any specific SLA or region constraints

I’ll be on the call if you want a quick production routing/quantization overview. Grace — tagging you for sandbox provisioning ops if we need a dedicated sandbox.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Developer Ecosystem
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@retailrise.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 11:02:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick walk — availability

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. I pulled a couple of slots that match post‑11am ET next week:
• Tue 11/25 1:00pm–1:30pm ET
• Wed 11/26 2:30pm–3:00pm ET

If one of those works I’ll send a calendar invite and provision a temporary sandbox account (credentials + a short preflight checklist). If neither fits, reply with three windows that work for you next week and we’ll hold one tentatively.

Preflight (what I’ll provision ahead of the call):
- sandbox API key (scoped, 48hr)
- sample curl + Node snippets for quick smoke test
- shared Drive with a short checklist (latency test steps, token budget estimate)

Calendly (if you prefer self‑select): https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@retailrise.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 13:35:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick walk — availability

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the options. Quick update: our lead infra engineer is unexpectedly pulled into a morning outage on Tue/Wed, so both proposed slots conflict on our side. Could we move this to either:
• Fri 11/28 1:00pm–1:30pm ET, or
• Mon 12/01 3:00pm–3:30pm ET

Either works but prefer Fri if possible. Please hold a slot tentatively if you can. Also yes please provision the sandbox key ahead of time — we’ll run the smoke tests listed in the checklist.

Thanks —
Alex
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@retailrise.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API quick walk — availability

Alex — got it. I’ve tentatively held Fri 11/28 1:00pm–1:30pm ET on our side. If that’s confirmed by EOD tomorrow I’ll send a calendar invite and Grace will provision the sandbox key (you’ll get a secure link to credentials + the sandbox‑provisioning‑checklist.md).

If anything changes I’ll coordinate alternative windows — otherwise expect the invite and the provisioning link by Thursday afternoon PT.

Quick note: if you want us to run a quick ingest/throughput test before the call, share a short sample (s3 or zipped csv) and we’ll queue it — otherwise the smoke tests in the checklist are sufficient.

See you soon —
Dylan
SDR, Redwood Inference
